name: Kasar Khanaval
area: Kashid Village, near Hanuman Temple, Revdanda-Murud Road
why_it_matters: Kashid's seafood anchor — 15+ years on Revdanda-Murud Road, run from a low Konkan-style house next to the village Hanuman temple at the south end of the beach. Pomfret fry, crab masala and surmai thali come out cleaner than the resort-restaurant versions on Beach Road. 3.8 on Restaurant Guru across 254 reviews. Curly Tales calls the pomfret fry the best at Kashid Beach.
insider_tip: Order pomfret + sol kadhi together — the kokum-coconut kadhi is what Beach Road resorts get wrong. Lunch service stops around 3pm, resumes at 6:30pm. Open till 10:30pm. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Kashid Village, near Hanuman Temple, Revdanda-Murud Road, Kashid 402401

name: Sea Esta Resort & Cafe
why_it_matters: Beachside resort + cafe a short walk from Kashid main beach — multi-cuisine kitchen with a strong Malvani seafood lean. Balcony seating; resort-restaurant model (open to non-residents). Breakfast 7-10:30am, lunch 12:30-3:30pm, dinner 7:30-10:30pm.
insider_tip: Order the Malvani fish thali (₹500-600) at lunch; the surmai fry is the best single fish dish. Balcony tables book out Friday-Sunday — call ahead +91 8657 250 250.

name: Prakruti Resorts Nisarg Restaurant
why_it_matters: Prakruti Resorts is the MTDC-partner property at Kashid; its in-house Nisarg restaurant serves Malvani + Indian + Chinese + Continental plus a poolside bar. Non-residents welcome. The most reliable buffet on the strip — useful for groups with mixed appetites. Open 7am-10:30pm.
insider_tip: Weekend lunch buffet (₹600-700) clears the kitchen variety; the surmai curry is the standout. Poolside bar shuts at 10pm. Cards + UPI.

name: Hotel Atithi
why_it_matters: Road-side family eatery on the Kashid main strip — the budget alternative to the resort restaurants. Konkan thalis + dosa + misal pav menu. Popular with Maharashtra-state drivers + day-trip families. Cash + UPI; small TV-on-the-wall dining hall.
insider_tip: Fish thali (₹250-300) is the value order at lunch. Toilets basic but clean. Useful for non-resort travellers + bike tourers + groups on a budget. Open 11:30am-3pm + 7-10:30pm.
signature_address: Kashid main road, 1.5km from Prakruti Resorts, Kashid 402401
